one_line: Salesforce's enterprise B2C/B2B commerce platform exposed through Open Commerce API (OCAPI) and Commerce Cloud APIs.
auth_notes: REST/OCAPI requires a Commerce Cloud account with API client IDs and secret; client-credential (OAuth2) or JWT bearer grants produce bearer tokens; B2C/B2B instances each need API client configured in the Business Manager.
self_serve_notes: Enterprise SaaS — requires a Commerce Cloud subscription/sales process; no free solo signup. Dev/test sandboxes exist only within an active enterprise contract.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Open Commerce API (OCAPI) covering catalog, product, customers, baskets/carts, orders, payments and web services; B2B Commerce GraphQL API; headless storefront APIs
api_surface.webhook_note: Event hooks / webhooks available in newer Commerce Cloud releases (e.g., B2C event notifications); less mature than other platforms

existing_mcp.note: No official Commerce Cloud-specific MCP server verified; Salesforce has MCP servers for other products but none confirmed for Commerce Cloud

blocker: Enterprise-only: credentials require an active Salesforce Commerce Cloud subscription obtained through sales; no self-serve signup

evidence.note: Fetched text was a thin cookie-consent/JS shell (~1.6KB) with no content; facts from knowledge of Commerce Cloud OCAPI and enterprise gating plus official docs URL
